author: marthomahew
name: gameday
short: Game channels that open and close themselves.
description: Moves reusable game channels from a parking category into a live category before kickoff, renames them for the game and syncs permissions, then puts them back after. Vikings games get a game and a delayed channel, other primetime games one channel, and RedZone opens when several games kick off together. Uses ESPN's public scoreboard.
install_msg: Loaded? Make sure you have categories named "game threads" and "gameday placeholder", then `[p]gameday setup` and `[p]gameday toggle`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
